customManagers.description: Track each SemanticMediaWiki CI matrix leg as its own dependency (keyed by the leg's mediawiki_version), since smw_version flows into build/Dockerfile's composer-require call and plain detection in ci.yml does not see it at all.

packageRules.description: grunt-eslint 25+ bundles eslint 9+, but eslint-config-wikimedia 0.32.x requires eslint ^8.57 and .eslintrc.json is the legacy format. Remove this ceiling once eslint-config-wikimedia and the ESLint configuration are moved to eslint 9 and the flat config format, and upgrade them together in the same PR (checked 2026-11-28).
The MW 1.43 CI leg tests SMW 7.x. A new SMW major has not been verified against this extension yet, so keep it below 8.0.0 until a leg has run green with it.
The MW 1.46 CI leg tests SMW 7.x. A new SMW major has not been verified against this extension yet, so keep it below 8.0.0 until a leg has run green with it.
Both CI legs use the same mariadb:12.x image (single value, so no per-leg split). Keep it on the 12.x line the other extensions test against until a newer major has been verified.
